name: 3DGS_Synthetic_Image_Benchmark
description: Synthetic-image benchmark providing rendered 3D scenes to evaluate computer vision models on tasks such as object recognition, detection, and segmentation in controlled, synthetic environments. Designed to measure robustness to viewpoint, lighting, and geometry variations common in synthetic-to-real research.
reputation: A small synthetic benchmark shared on Hugging Face that is primarily of interest to researchers working on synthetic-to-real transfer and 3D scene understanding.
